name: linggen
description: Linggen for Codex — one MCP front door to the local Linggen daemon: durable cross-host memory, browser control, logged-in X reads. Installs its required binaries (ling-mem + the Linggen engine, background download) on first session start.

interface.shortDescription: Memory, browser control, and session reads from the local Linggen daemon.
interface.longDescription: One MCP connection to the Linggen daemon: durable cross-host memory (core identity, long-term semantic, episodic staging), agent browser control in your own Chrome with per-site permission prompts, and structured reads of your logged-in X session.
